# NFL Daily — 2026-07-26 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 07/26: Cardinals reworked QB Jacoby Brissett's contract to a one-year deal worth $15.5M guaranteed (up to $21M with incentives), locking him in as the Week 1 starter. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49456720/source-cardinals-brissett-guaranteed-155m-reworked-deal)
- 07/26: Patriots owner Robert Kraft said the team has offered CB Christian Gonzalez a contract that would make him the highest-paid corner in NFL history. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49447151/kraft-patriots-gonzalez-offer-highest-paid-cb-ever)
- 07/26: Lions placed starting Ss Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph and TE Tyler Conklin on the PUP list; all three miss a minimum of four games if still listed when the season starts. [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7471617/2026/07/26/lions-kerby-joseph-brian-branch-pup-list/)
- 07/26: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan will start training camp in a limited role after a July 14 car accident left him with a broken nose, three broken ribs, a broken hand, a concussion and 40+ stitches; GM John Lynch said he's still expected to coach the Sept. 10 opener. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/kyle-shanahan-car-accident-injuries-49ers-training-camp/)
- 07/26: Rams DT Aaron Donald's potential return drew a cautious "excited" from coach Sean McVay, who said the retired star is going through a "regimented process." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49448508/retired-donald-regimented-process-possible-rams-return)
- 07/25-26: Bears opened camp with six defensive starters — including LB T.J. Edwards and LB Noah Sewell (Achilles) — on the PUP/non-football injury list. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

## Transactions
- 07/26: Lions placed Ss Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph and TE Tyler Conklin on the active/PUP list. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/transactions)
- 07/26: 49ers placed TE George Kittle, DL Alfred Collins, DL Mykel Williams and RB Isaac Guerendo on the active/PUP list; signed DL Kevin Givens to a one-year contract and waived DL Evan Anderson. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/transactions)

## Injuries
- 07/25: T.J. Edwards (LB) — Chicago Bears: placed on the active/non-football injury list Saturday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- 07/26: Noah Sewell (LB) — Chicago Bears: placed on the active/PUP list (Achilles). [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- 07/26: Kyler Gordon (CB) — Chicago Bears: placed on the active/PUP list (undisclosed). [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
